description: Power-user escape hatch: GET any YCBM API path not wrapped by a dedicated tool. READ-ONLY — only GET is allowed. Pass the FULL API path after the origin, starting with a slash, INCLUDING any query string, e.g. "/v1/bookings?maxResults=5" or "/v1/profiles". Returns the parsed JSON.

path.description: Full API path after the origin, starting with "/", e.g. "/v1/bookings?maxResults=5".

title: Raw read request
